description: Zero-shot dermatology image classifier over thirteen configured conditions. Takes a clinical PNG or JPEG image and returns a visual-token Grad-CAM overlay plus candidate-relative probabilities.
disease: acne, actinic keratosis, basal cell carcinoma, eczema, melanoma, nevus, psoriasis, rosacea, seborrheic keratosis, squamous cell carcinoma, tinea, urticaria, viral wart
